3989	async function executeRun(
3990		app: AppSpec,
3991		lane: Lane,
3992		pass: 1 | 2,
3993		options: {
3994			laneRoot?: string;
3995			receiptRoot?: string;
3996			nextPrerenderPayload?: NextPrerenderPayloadInput;
3997			serviceWorkerPolicy?: 'canonical' | 'zero';
3998		} = {},
3999	): Promise<WitnessRealAppRun> {
4000		const laneRoot = options.laneRoot ?? join(stageRoot, 'lanes', app.app, lane);
4001		const receiptDir = join(
4002			options.receiptRoot ?? join(stageRoot, 'witness-receipts'),
4003			app.app,
4004			lane,
4005			`pass-${pass}`,
4006		);
4007		await rm(receiptDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
4008		const beforeInventory = await staticInventory(laneRoot);
4009		const contextProfile =
4010			app.app === 'react-boilerplate' &&
4011			lane === 'baseline' &&
4012			options.serviceWorkerPolicy !== 'zero'
4013				? ('canonical-t060' as const)
4014				: ('current-witness' as const);
4015		const loopback = app.loopback?.();
4016		const staticServer = await startStaticServer(laneRoot, {
4017			profile: contextProfile,
4018			api: loopback?.api,
4019			upgrade: loopback?.upgrade,
4020		});
4021		const productionUrl = joinURL(staticServer.origin, app.initialRoute ?? '/');
4022		const transportEvidence: JourneyTransportEvidence = { apiUsernames: [] };
